title: Scaling Shopify: Tobias Lütke and Ben Horowitz on Building a Global Giant

reader_summary.headline: When Shopify was founded in 2006, it was just a year prior to the launch of the iPhone.
reader_summary.overview: When Shopify was founded in 2006, it was just a year prior to the launch of the iPhone. Needless to say, smartphones were a far cry from the ubiquitous accessory that now billions carry around. And fast forward to today, nearly 20 years later, where Shopify merchants can accept cryptocurrency, create immersive shopping experiences with augmented reality.

key_points.text: And fast forward to today, nearly 20 years later, where Shopify merchants can accept cryptocurrency, create immersive shopping experiences with augmented reality.
key_points.evidence_quote: And fast forward to today, nearly 20 years later, where Shopify merchants can accept cryptocurrency, create immersive shopping experiences with augmented reality, and even use AI to generate product descriptions.

key_points.text: So how does a nearly $100 billion company stay ahead of these trends?
key_points.evidence_quote: So how does a nearly $100 billion company stay ahead of these trends?

key_points.text: Plus, why would A16Z never have invested in Shopify in its early day?
key_points.evidence_quote: Plus, why would A16Z never have invested in Shopify in its early day?

key_points.text: And why has the CEO of this company chosen to continue writing code?
key_points.evidence_quote: And why has the CEO of this company chosen to continue writing code?

thesis: The conversation explores how Shopify evolved from a snowboarding company founded by a non-resident in Canada who could not get a job due to lack of a work permit. The speakers discuss the moral imperative of building high-quality software for digital natives rather than existing retailers, noting that A16Z likely would not have invested early because the e-commerce category was heavily overcompeted.
